_about: Lightning comparison of 2026-11-01 with the GPUlayer 0.8.0 Trainer (ADR-0024), every case on one AWS g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU Xeon Platinum 8259CL, 1x Tesla T4), lightning-comparison.log. Replaces the 2026-10-31 GCP T4 run in the charts. Read by scripts/make_perf_charts.py.

training_vs_lightning.hardware: AWS g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU, 1x Tesla T4, driver 595.112.07), Deep Learning Base OSS NVIDIA driver AMI (Ubuntu 22.04), Python 3.12, torch 2.15.0+cu132, Lightning 2.6.6, GPUlayer 0.8.0; Spot
training_vs_lightning.subtitle: Same model, data and optimizer on one Tesla T4 (AWS g4dn.xlarge), torch 2.15, Lightning 2.6.6, GPUlayer 0.8
training_vs_lightning.method: benchmarks/trainer_comparison/run.py: 100 and 600 steps, 3 runs each in fresh processes, one at a time; ms/step = (median 600 - median 100) / 500; start-up = median 100-step wall - 100 x step. The DDP case runs 2 CPU processes on the same 4-vCPU machine.
